items.title: Over 60,000 Attacks Target WordPress RCE Vulnerability Within 24 Hours
items.description: Hackers are targeting a WordPress Core remote code execution vulnerability that can expose websites during software updates. The supplied Wordfence threat intelligence snapshot lists 60,471 blocked attempts over 24 hours. These are attack attempts, not confirmed website compromises, and the figure does not establish how many individual sites were targeted. WordPress released version 7.1.4 on […]…

items.title: A Shared ChatGPT Link Could Run Attacker Code in Your Session and Read Private Chats
items.description: A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it, allowing them to read their private conversations, researchers at the security firm Parameter showed. The researchers reported the flaw through OpenAI's bug bounty program on October 18, and OpenAI fixed it eight days later and rated it P1, its most serious category.

items.title: Cloudflare Reports 18.2 Million Network-Layer DDoS Attacks in Q3, Up 38%
items.description: Threat actors are launching about 8,226 network-layer distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks per hour, Cloudflare revealed Thursday. The web infrastructure and security company said it autonomously mitigated 18.2 million network-layer (L3) DDoS attacks and 14.4 trillion HTTP DDoS requests in the third quarter of 2026. items.description: Google has announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest AI model built to find software flaws, test whether attackers could exploit them, and produce fixes. items.title: TeamViewer Security Flaw Could Turn Remote Support Sessions Into Computer Takeovers
items.description: A newly disclosed TeamViewer vulnerability could let an attacker turn a routine remote support session against the technician providing help. Tracked as CVE-2026-111585, the flaw allows a malicious remote computer to crash the viewer application and potentially run code on the technician’s machine. TeamViewer rates it High, with a CVSS score of 8.8. Remedio researcher […] The post TeamViewer…

items.title: Anthropic’s Claude Bypasses AI Safety Checks, Triggering Blackmail and Code Sabotage in Tests
items.description: Anthropic researchers have shown that Claude can design training data that slips past an AI safety monitor and causes a separate research model to blackmail users, weaken security code, and resist oversight. The October 2026 study exposes a gap between text that looks safe during screening and behavior learned through training. The distinction matters. These […] The post Anthropic’s Claude…

items.description: TeamViewer has fixed a flaw that lets the machine being controlled in a remote session attack the computer that connected to control it. items.title: SS7 and Diameter Attacks: How Signaling Flaws Expose Your Phone
items.description: Flaws in SS7 and Diameter signaling protocols can allow attackers to track phone locations, intercept calls and SMS verification codes, and impersonate subscribers without compromising their devices. Cape explains how these attacks exploit trust between networks and how its security-focused mobile service helps defend against them. [...]
